name: Hydrocracking (fixed bed)
principle: Vacuum gas oil and hydrogen pass at high pressure over a pretreatment catalyst that removes nitrogen and sulfur, then over a cracking catalyst with acid and metal functions that breaks heavy molecules into diesel, jet and naphtha while saturating them. Unconverted oil can be recycled to a second stage or sent to lube units or the FCC.

performance.metric: conversion of straight-run VGO (revamped two-stage recycle unit)
performance.basis: CLG case study (upwards of 80%); unit revamped from 40,000 to 64,000 b/d fresh VGO

source.note: PTQ, Revamping an integrated hydrocracker and lube base oil unit, Chevron Lummus Global and ART, December 2020

advantages: High yields of clean middle distillates
Products low in sulfur and aromatics
Integrates with lube base oil production
limitations: Feed nitrogen and metals shorten catalyst life
